build_escnmd_block: build an eSCNMD_Block for equivariant spherical convolutional neural network message passing with edge-wise and atom-wise layers
create_edgewise_module: create an Edgewise module using SO2 convolutions and gate or S2 activation for edge-based message passing
create_spectral_atomwise_module: create a SpectralAtomwise module with SO3 linear layers and gate activation for spectral atom-wise transformations
create_grid_atomwise_module: create a GridAtomwise module that projects spherical harmonics to a grid for point-wise MLP operations
set_mole_ac_start_index: set the activation checkpointing start index on all MOLE submodules within a given PyTorch module
